components.role_instruction: You are a video generation system producing a coherent first-person navigation clip.
components.action_description: Move forward naturally and continuously, following the instruction: {initial_prompt}
components.loop_completion_requirement: Complete a loop: by the end of the video, return to the starting viewpoint and match the initial scene composition as closely as possible.
components.temporal_consistency_constraints: Maintain stable motion and consistent scene layout across time; avoid progressive drift.
components.scene_preservation_constraints: Preserve the same environment, objects, and lighting; do not introduce new rooms or major changes.
components.negative_constraints: Do not cut, teleport, or abruptly jump; do not change to a different location; avoid jitter and discontinuities.
